note: Round-2 proposals for the design pass: names and looks only. Nothing here is declared in the game or in game.json; no prices, no counts, no dates. The game has no game.json yet, so 'moments' are proposed too: each is something the current build already records.

moments.name: Bead
moments.rule: Change into the Bead: a glass mantle closes around you.
moments.glyph: a pearl inside an offset glass shell

moments.name: Halo
moments.rule: Change into the Chimera and grow a halo.
moments.glyph: a tilted ring floating over a bead

moments.name: Nova
moments.rule: Change into the Nova: a small star lights inside you.
moments.glyph: a four-point star inside a bead

moments.name: The Bell
moments.rule: Unmake the Bell of Nacre, the first world's heart.

moments.name: The Geode
moments.rule: Find the Geode and open its heart.

moments.name: A Star
moments.rule: Reach the Eclipse and end a journey as a star.
moments.glyph: a dark disc in a broken ring of rays

moments.name: Four Forms
moments.rule: Become each of the four final forms.

moments.name: The Constellation
moments.rule: Light every star of the constellation.

store.verb_look: a bead of liquid pearl lands in the tile's lower-left corner and closes into a small pearl seal with one ripple

items.name: Pearl Moonlet

pass.name: Pearl Orbit

rewards.name: Mote Trail

rewards.name: Pearl Crest

rewards.name: Prism Halo
